args.sql:
SELECT a.acct_ref, ca.content_metrics->'posting'->>'posts_per_day' as posts_per_day,
       ca.content_metrics->'content_quality'->>'content_uniqueness' as cu,
       ca.content_metrics->'link_media'->>'media_reuse_rate' as mrr,
       im."TxtUniq" as txtuniq
FROM accounts a
JOIN content_activity ca ON ca.acct_slot = a.acct_ref
JOIN interaction_metrics im ON im.acct_dm = a.acct_ref
LIMIT 5;

SELECT a.acct_ref, 
       CAST(ca.content_metrics->'posting'->>'posts_per_day' AS numeric) as posts_per_day,
       ROUND(CAST(
         0.4 * (1 - COALESCE(CAST(ca.content_metrics->'content_quality'->>'content_uniqueness' AS numeric), 0))
         + 0.3 * COALESCE(CAST(ca.content_metrics->'link_media'->>'media_reuse_rate' AS numeric), 0)
         + 0.3 * (1 - COALESCE(CAST(im."TxtUniq" AS numeric), 0))
       AS numeric), 4) as cms
FROM accounts a
JOIN content_activity ca ON ca.acct_slot = a.acct_ref
JOIN interaction_metrics im ON im.acct_dm = a.acct_ref
WHERE CAST(ca.content_metrics->'posting'->>'posts_per_day' AS numeric) > 50
  AND 0.4 * (1 - COALESCE(CAST(ca.content_metrics->'content_quality'->>'content_uniqueness' AS numeric), 0))
    + 0.3 * COALESCE(CAST(ca.content_metrics->'link_media'->>'media_reuse_rate' AS numeric), 0)
    + 0.3 * (1 - COALESCE(CAST(im."TxtUniq" AS numeric), 0)) > 0.7;

SELECT a.acct_ref, p.HandleMask, 
       CAST(ca.content_metrics->'posting'->>'posts_per_day' AS numeric) as posts_per_day,
       ROUND(CAST(
         0.4 * (1 - COALESCE(CAST(ca.content_metrics->'content_quality'->>'content_uniqueness' AS numeric), 0))
         + 0.3 * COALESCE(CAST(ca.content_metrics->'link_media'->>'media_reuse_rate' AS numeric), 0)
         + 0.3 * (1 - COALESCE(CAST(im."TxtUniq" AS numeric), 0))
       AS numeric), 4) as cms
FROM accounts a
JOIN content_activity ca ON ca.acct_slot = a.acct_ref
JOIN interaction_metrics im ON im.acct_dm = a.acct_ref
JOIN profiles p ON p.acct_anchor = a.acct_ref
WHERE CAST(ca.content_metrics->'posting'->>'posts_per_day' AS numeric) > 50
  AND 0.4 * (1 - COALESCE(CAST(ca.content_metrics->'content_quality'->>'content_uniqueness' AS numeric), 0))
    + 0.3 * COALESCE(CAST(ca.content_metrics->'link_media'->>'media_reuse_rate' AS numeric), 0)
    + 0.3 * (1 - COALESCE(CAST(im."TxtUniq" AS numeric), 0)) > 0.7
ORDER BY posts_per_day DESC;
